gbm_population_evidence.quote: The subject is a person with a histologically proven diagnosis of glioblastoma (GB) according to WHO 2016.

candidate_evidence.quote: 11C-Methionine PET/CT will be applied in patients in 11C-Methionine PET/CT Arm, based on planning MRI, prior chemo/radiotherapy (2 weeks prior C1D1)
For patients who undergo this examination, the radiotherapy planning will be adjusted based on it.

role_evidence.quote: Patients who develop REP within approximately 6 weeks after surgery will have PET/CT (positron emission tomography in combination with computed tomography) examinations using the radiopharmaceutical 11C-methionine in addition to standard practice.

agents.drug_class_hint: carbon-11 labelled methionine amino-acid PET tracer (diagnostic imaging for radiotherapy planning)

source_quote.quote: Mutational status of TERT and IDH2: mutated/wild-type
Immunohistochemical analysis of GFAP, Ki-67, IDH1, ATRX, and PDL1.
MGMT promotor methylation status: ≥25% = methylated/\<25% = unmethylated
Mutational status of TERT and IDH2: mutated/wild-type

coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging trial: the only registered drug intervention is the 11C-methionine PET tracer used to adjust radiotherapy planning; no antitumour candidate (S6 fails). Comparator is a historical NO_INTERVENTION cohort. Patients receive standard adjuvant chemoradiotherapy outside the protocol question; temozolomide is mentioned only as background (Stupp history), not as a protocol agent every patient receives, so not listed. GFAP and Ki-67 IHC treated as routine histology and not recorded as molecular biomarkers. Exploratory biomarkers apply to the prospective arm (not arm-restricted in the record).
